WITH event_level AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.status,
    AVG(b.remaining) as avg_remaining,
    AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) as avg_overspend_rate
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),

global_mean_remaining AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) as global_mean
  FROM event_level
),

status_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_remaining,
    AVG(avg_overspend_rate) as avg_overspend_rate
  FROM event_level
  GROUP BY status
)

SELECT 
  s.status,
  s.avg_remaining,
  s.avg_overspend_rate,
  s.avg_remaining / NULLIF(g.global_mean, 0) as ratio
FROM status_aggregates s
CROSS JOIN global_mean_remaining g

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero handling: NULLIF converts zero denominators to NULL, which AVG() then ignores. If budget.amount is zero or the global mean is zero, the division yields NULL. The request does not specify how to handle division by zero.
